name: Fly Away
source:
Fly Away is a self-insert lgbt friendly dating sim where you can try to get closer to five male love interests in a world of magical realism. 

[from [url=https://yumowowo.itch.io/flyawaydemo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《展翅高飞》是一款支持自我代入的LGBT友好向恋爱模拟游戏，你将在充满魔幻现实主义色彩的世界里，尝试拉近与五位男性可攻略角色之间的距离。

[摘自[url=https://yumowowo.itch.io/flyawaydemo]itch.io[/url]]
